  function automatic [88:0] fma_s1(input logic [15:0] a, input logic [15:0] b, input logic [15:0] c);
    logic        sga, sgb, sgc;
    logic [4:0]  ea, eb, ec;
    logic [9:0]  ma, mb, mc;
    logic        anan, bnan, cnan, ainf, binf, cinf, azero, bzero;
    logic [10:0]      MA, MB, MC;
    logic signed [5:0] EA, EB, EC;
    logic [21:0]      MP;
    logic signed [6:0] EP;
    logic [6:0]       sp, scp;
    logic [83:0]      Pf, Cf, Tp, Tc, T;
    logic [1:0]       spec;
    logic             isig, spq, scq;
    begin
      sga = a[15]; ea = a[14:10]; ma = a[9:0];
      sgb = b[15]; eb = b[14:10]; mb = b[9:0];
      sgc = c[15]; ec = c[14:10]; mc = c[9:0];
      anan  = (ea == 5'h1F) && (ma != 10'd0);
      bnan  = (eb == 5'h1F) && (mb != 10'd0);
      cnan  = (ec == 5'h1F) && (mc != 10'd0);
      ainf  = (ea == 5'h1F) && (ma == 10'd0);
      binf  = (eb == 5'h1F) && (mb == 10'd0);
      cinf  = (ec == 5'h1F) && (mc == 10'd0);
      azero = (ea == 5'd0) && (ma == 10'd0);
      bzero = (eb == 5'd0) && (mb == 10'd0);
      spq   = sga ^ sgb;
      scq   = sgc;
      spec  = 2'd0;
      isig  = 1'b0;
      T     = 84'd0;
      if (anan || bnan || cnan) begin
        spec = 2'd1;
      end else if ((ainf && bzero) || (azero && binf)) begin
        spec = 2'd2;
      end else if (ainf || binf) begin
        isig = spq;
        if (cinf && (sgc != spq)) begin
          spec = 2'd2;
        end else begin
          spec = 2'd3;
        end

        spec = 2'd3;
        isig = sgc;
      end else begin
        MA = (ea == 5'd0) ? {1'b0, ma} : {1'b1, ma};
        MB = (eb == 5'd0) ? {1'b0, mb} : {1'b1, mb};
        MC = (ec == 5'd0) ? {1'b0, mc} : {1'b1, mc};
        EA = (ea == 5'd0) ? -6'sd24 : ($signed({1'b0, ea}) - 6'sd25);
        EB = (eb == 5'd0) ? -6'sd24 : ($signed({1'b0, eb}) - 6'sd25);
        EC = (ec == 5'd0) ? -6'sd24 : ($signed({1'b0, ec}) - 6'sd25);

        EP = $signed(EA) + $signed(EB);
        sp  = EP + 7'sd50;
        scp = $signed(EC) + 7'sd50;
        Pf = {62'd0, MP} << sp;
        Cf = {73'd0, MC} << scp;
        Tp = spq ? (~Pf + 84'd1) : Pf;
        Tc = scq ? (~Cf + 84'd1) : Cf;
        T  = Tp + Tc;
      end
      fma_s1 = {T, spq, scq, spec, isig};
    end
  endfunction

              res = {sres, fld, sig[9:0]};
